Name: Shaved Ice and Frozen Treats - Chinese Simplified
Author: kiwipart
Description:
[color=#f6b26b][size=4][b]原 mod[/b]:[/size] [/color][size=4] [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5388]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5388[/url][/size]

 
[size=3]我翻译了Hadi、Zosa和Fwippy的“刨冰和冷冻零食” 2.1版本。事实上已经有一个旧版本的中文翻译（由asqwedcxz741制作），所以我增加了2.1版本新内容的中文翻译，大部分都是刨冰。[/size]

[color=#f6b26b][size=3][b]安装：[/b][/size][/color]
[size=3]1- 首先必须安装原mod“刨冰和冷冻零食”以及该mod的所需前置 到“Mods”文件夹。（具体请参照原mod界面）[/size]
[size=3]2- 解压本翻译文件得到一个[JA]文件夹。将它剪切并粘贴到原mod的相同名字的文件夹中。[/size]
[size=3]3- 此处应会提示“是否替换相同名称的文件”（如果没有这个提示就是粘贴错位置了），选择“是”。[/size]
[size=3]4- 打开游戏，这时应该能够看到中文翻译了：D

如果对翻译文件有疑问，可以给我评论。此mod的所有权利归原作者Hadi，Zosa 和 Fwippy所有。
 


[/size][size=3]HI! I translated Hadi, Zosa and Fwippy's [b][color=#f6b26b]Shaved Ice and Frozen Treats[/color][/b] to the newest version(2.1). The Chinese translation has already been added in the early version（made by asqwedcxz741）, so I only work on the new items 2.1 added. Most of them are shaved ice.

[/size][size=3][color=#f6b26b][b]Installation:[/b][/color]
1- You must have Shaved Ice and Frozen Treats and all of its requirements installed in the “Mod” folder. 
2- Unzip the translation file and there will be a [JA]folder. Cut and paste it into the same folder in the original mod.
3- There should be a sign whether to replace the files with the same name, choose “yes”.
4- Start the game and enjoy!

If any problems related to translation file, leave me a comment and I‘ll try to handle it. All rights of assets reserved to the original author, Hadi ,Zosa and Fwippy.[/size]
